answer: Sequential Work-Proof Lottery. Each new identity must complete a random micro-task chain whose length is drawn from a public lotus seed, and the result is only accepted if its timing profile matches an honest worker's. Cloning forces the attacker to solve every chain in real time, so each fake identity costs the same compute and latency as one genuine worker. Honest agents pay one chain per epoch; a sybil farm pays N chains and gains no pearl of extra throughput, since rewards scale with verified chains, not identities. The orchard of valid tasks grows only through real work.
